headline: Week 7: Breece Hall is unlikely to play, so bench him and start Kendre Miller before 6:30 AM Pacific if you added him, or MarShawn Lloyd if not.
alerts: Breece Hall is unlikely to play per Ian Rapoport Sunday morning. Bench him. Jets inactives post about 8:30 AM Pacific.
Kendre Miller is active for the Saints in Paris and locks at 6:30 AM Pacific. If you added him, start him at RB2 now.
If you did not add Miller, start MarShawn Lloyd (GB, 1:25 PM Pacific) in Hall's spot.
Brian Robinson is OUT. Make sure he is not in your lineup.
You still need a kicker. Add Jake Bates or Chad Ryland before 10:00 AM Pacific, or the K slot scores zero.
Josh Jacobs is activated and will play, which caps Lloyd's role.
Sleeper could not be reached again this run, so the roster is from an earlier run. Confirm your lineup in the app.

ARI.note: At Denver Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific. Broncos -4 to -4.5, total 43.5. RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) out, QB2 Carson Beck questionable.

GB.note: At Detroit Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. Lions -3, total 53.5. Jacobs activated and will play.

DET.note: Vs. Green Bay Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. About 28 implied. C Cade Mays and DB Brian Branch questionable.

ATL.note: Vs. San Francisco Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. 49ers -2.5, total 49.5, line moved toward Atlanta. Brian Robinson out.

MIN.note: Vs. Indianapolis Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Vikings -6.5, total 41.5. Jordan Mason returning.

IND.note: At Minnesota Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Warren, Gould and Gardner all out.

NYJ.note: Vs. Miami Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Jets -4.5, total 39.5. Breece Hall unlikely to play, Braelon Allen and Isaiah Davis to split.

DAL.note: At Philadelphia Monday 5:15 PM Pacific. Cowboys -4 to -4.5, total 44.5. Pickens full Friday.

PHI.note: Vs. Dallas Monday 5:15 PM Pacific. DeVonta Smith out. Barkley still leaning toward playing.

NO.note: Vs. Pittsburgh in Paris Sunday 6:30 AM Pacific, the earliest lock. Steelers -3.5, total 44.5. Saints inactives: G Cesar Ruiz, DL Nathan Shepherd, Kendre Miller active.

3257.name: Jacoby Brissett
notes: At Denver Sunday 1:05 PM Pacific. Broncos -4 to -4.5, total 43.5, Arizona about 19.5 implied.
RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is out again, so the offense leans on the pass. Backup QB Carson Beck (back) is questionable.
Only healthy QB on the roster with Hurts on IR, so he starts by default.
